summary: Full end-to-end verification of v59 Brain Phase B (iter-204). All 5 new GET brain endpoints verified live on the preview URL for admin@stoicaibot.com (cookie session auth). /api/brain/degraded → mode=NORMAL with 9 subsystems each carrying policy{fallback,risk_multiplier}; /api/brain/costs?symbol=XAUUSD → cost_r=0.06, required_edge_r=0.08 (= cost_r+0.02), full components dict; /api/brain/memory?symbol=XAUUSD → market_state populated, memory.available=false with 'insufficient comparable situations (0/8)' note, verdict OK×1.0 (CORRECT for empty admin history); /api/brain/strategy-health → {strategies:[]}; /api/brain/decisions?limit=5 → {decisions:[]}; /api/brain/decisions/does_not_exist → 404. New pytest suite (19/19) passes; regression suite (unit + iter148 + iter149 + iter150.TestEaSourceScenarios + iter202_phase_a + iter201 + sec001 + iter204) = 521/521 passed. Added 5 new data-level integration tests in tests/test_iter204_brain_phase_b_integration.py — all pass — covering DecisionContext mint/record_stage/get_decision + tenant isolation, Market Memory recall with seeded negative-skew history (n=50 → REDUCE/AVOID verdict) + empty-history fallback, Outcome Attribution 2.0 counterfactuals + engine_version=3 persistence, Strategy Decay unproven + flagged states. Frontend /signals renders brain-phase-b-panel with NORMAL chip and all 4 sub-panels (strategy-health-board, market-memory-panel, cost-model-panel, decision-inspector) showing the correct empty-state copy for the admin account; no layout breaks. Grand total with new tests: 526/526 passing.
action_items: None — release ready. Test manifest was regenerated (docs/TEST_MANIFEST.md now lists 3392 tests / 335 files) to reflect the new integration test file, per agent-to-agent note.
critical_code_review_comments: decision_context.py: clean design (immutable snapshot, MAX_STAGES=40 cap, tenant-isolated get_decision, indexes on decision_id unique + (user_id, at)). Non-blocking on mint failures — pipeline never blocks on bookkeeping — good defensive posture.
market_memory.py: sensible cosine-over-shared-dims similarity (needs >=5 shared keys), recency half-life (30d), MIN_MATCHES=8 gate, downscale-only verdict (never boosts) — matches spec.

outcome_attribution.py: ENGINE_VERSION=3 correctly bumped; counterfactuals dict includes actual_r + no_trade_r always, plus median_broker_slippage_r/earlier_entry_r/correct_regime_r conditionally — matches spec (v3).

strategy_decay.py: attribution guard soft-drops one flag when >50% of recent losses are noise-primary (EXECUTION/BROKER/INFRA/NEWS) — great to avoid retraining on infra losses. 15-min health cache is sensible.
canary_promotion.py.start_canary: q.qualified is False → raises ValueError with 'qualification 2.0 not passed' — hard block, correct. Advisory when qualify returns None (insufficient data).
distributed_rate_limit fail_closed=True + write class returns (False,{fail_closed:true,degraded:true}) — the invariant the spec demands and the unit test exercises.
brain_routes.py: GET /api/brain/decisions/{id} correctly returns 404 for unknown ids; admin path uses admin=True to bypass tenant filter (verified end-to-end).
Frontend BrainPhaseBPanel.jsx: all four required data-testids present + degraded-mode-chip; empty-state copy is user-friendly and consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 Phase-B sub-panels rendered with correct data-testids and empty-state copy; NORMAL chip visible; no layout break)

context_for_next_testing_agent: v59 Brain Phase B is fully verified — no outstanding issues. The 401s observed in browser console on /signals are periodic background auth-refresh polling races unrelated to Phase B; the panel renders correctly. Two market-memory notes for future testers: (1) recall() requires >=8 similar matches AND the market_memory.verdict function requires confidence>=0.5 (which needs n_eff>=20 in practice) to trigger REDUCE — that's why my initial seed of 15 trades still returned OK; 50 trades comfortably crosses the threshold. (2) outcome_attribution._signals reads slippage from the TRADE doc (trade['slippage']), not from the linked signal — so counterfactual normal_execution_r/median_broker_slippage_r assertions must seed slippage on the trade.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. The release ships clean: DecisionContext threading (mint → stages → trade.decision_id), Market Memory downscale-only verdict with attribution-aware verdict function, Outcome Attribution v3 counterfactuals, Strategy Decay ladder with noise guard, Champion/Challenger 2.0 hard-blocking canary_promotion.start_canary when qualified=False, dynamic transaction costs feeding uncertainty engine, Degraded Intelligence policy dict for 9 subsystems, and fail-closed limiter on financial writes are all functioning as designed.
